title: 99.5% accuracy, no frauds caught
summary: Why accuracy, precision, and recall part ways on a rare class.

choices.text: Accuracy is the wrong headline here. Report precision and recall on the fraud class: recall is the share of frauds caught, precision the share of fraud alerts that are real.
Accuracy is fine once the test set is resampled to 50% fraud: quote accuracy on that balanced set, and it then reflects how good the alerts will be in production.
Report ROC AUC alone. It does not depend on the 0.5% base rate, so it also tells you what share of the fraud alerts in production will be real.
Report specificity and the false positive rate. With 99.5% of traffic legitimate, those two numbers describe almost every decision the model makes.
